audience: managers and operations leads who review tracked time, shifts and productivity in Time Doctor

useCases.title: Compare tracked time across groups
useCases.text: List the groups of the company, then read the tracked and idle time totals of a group for a date range.

useCases.title: Read the activity timeline of one user
useCases.text: Find the user, then read the tracked activity intervals for a date range. A plain start date means the start of that UTC day.

useCases.title: Check the productive share of time
useCases.text: Read the tracked time per productivity category for users or groups in a date range.

useCases.title: Review projects and tasks
useCases.text: List the projects of the company and the tasks in some of them. Read one task by id.

useCases.title: Check shifts and approved leave
useCases.text: List scheduled shifts and leave for users in a date range, with their approval state.

useCases.title: Pick a reporting timezone
useCases.text: Read the company ids with whoami, then list the timezones used by the company's users before you run a report.
